item.title: Air France-KLM Hits €2 Billion Profit Milestone as Premium Anchors Outlook
item.description: Premium travelers, led by U.S. outbound, are keeping Europe’s network carriers profitable even as demand in the rest of the plane – and other parts of the world – softens.

item.title: Wyndham Works With Google and Anthropic on AI Bookings
item.description: AI booking platforms could become the new gatekeepers of travel demand. Wyndham is among the hotel groups plugging in their inventory and hoping to capture bookings at a lower cost than through OTAs.

item.title: Accor Pushes to Sell Stake in Essendi, the Hotel Owner It Spun Off in 2017
item.description: Accor’s Essendi update signals a complex, multi-shareholder deal that hinges on governance talks, not just price, with management still targeting a 2026 close.

item.title: U.S. Inbound Tourism Slump Deepens to Start 2026
item.description: Travel executives are hopeful for a rebound, but visits to the U.S. remain well below pre-pandemic levels.

item.title: United Shakes Up MileagePlus: Here’s What’s Changing
item.description: United is overhauling its MileagePlus program to give more awards to those with the carrier’s credit cards as it looks to attract more high-spend travelers.

item.title: Tripadvisor CEO Issued Confidential Memo to Employees on ‘Challenging’ Month: Scoop
item.description: There are conflicting messages at Tripadvisor these days. Goldberg told employees that it "will take time" for its 3-month-old strategy revamp "to show up in the numbers." Meanwhile, activist investor Starboard Value argued "the time for incrementalism is over."

item.title: The Hotel Industry Wasn’t Built for This. Nothing Was.
item.description: ICE's Operation Metro Surge in Minneapolis revealed what happens when hotels become political battlegrounds — and why the industry isn't ready for what's coming.

item.title: Choice Hotels’ Purge: Sheds Weak Properties to Lift Brand Quality
item.description: Choice Hotels is doing something none of its publicly traded rivals are doing right now: getting smaller on purpose.

item.title: Las Vegas Tourism Suffers Sharp Decline
item.description: The same forces weighing on U.S. travel are hitting Las Vegas especially hard.

item.title: Sabre Lays Off Staff Amid C-Suite Reshuffle in Bid to Become ‘AI-Native’
item.description: Reports are coming in about layoffs, from London to Uruguay, showing the impact of Sabre’s ‘inflation offset program.’ That and several leadership shifts show how Sabre is restructuring around agentic AI.
